notes.title: September Development Update
notes.content: [h1]September Development Update[/h1][p][/p][p]The last couple of months have been very busy! A lot of life admin, as well as working on upskilling in a areas such as digital and 3D artwork.[/p][p]That said, I've been working on some fun new mechanics coming to you by the end of this year![/p][p][/p][h2]Sky Fishing![/h2][p]The tower has been built and sat waiting, but soon you'll finally be able to use it to go fishing in the sky![/p][p]Explore a floating temple and capture all new flying creatures.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/06101caa5f4b4de0f5158f503dfd537e7d58c62a.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Trinket Varieties![/h2][p]I'll be introducing some new ways to enhance your runs with trinkets that manipulate what sea opals can do for you![/p][p][/p][h2]Arcade Mode![/h2][p]A new arcade mode of playing is being introduced, where the goal is to fish as many days as you can with an ever increasing score goal.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience with the development of Stu the fisherman, I'm looking forward to getting this update out to you![/p][p][/p][p]All my best,[/p][p]Ben[/p][p]Savvy Games[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.2 - A whole new look!
notes.content: [h1]We're into 0.2![/h1][p]It's been a month since the early access release of Stu the fisherman and the feedback has been great![/p][p]I've been hard at work on this next update, which I think will be an exciting one for you all too.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Progression System[/h2][p]Everything up to this point has been numbers; multiply value by value and earn money to buy everything you'd ever need. This has changed.[/p][p]You now fish to earn points (still value x multiplier) which collect week-by-week towards earning rewards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/c916547060005a672f696986b142c7fec445ec17.png"][/img][/p][p]These can be new trinkets or materials that are used to upgrade your gear and rebuild the town![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/acfa481c235d8f225026d44a8dbaa78a81fd7eb0.png"][/img][/p][h2]Rainbow Fish[/h2][p]Mentioned in the devlog update, a whole new variant of fish has been added, these fish count as any colour, meaning that they count towards trinkets such as stone, glass and shell which all target colours individually! With this new variant come all new trinkets that convert your fish into the rainbow variant![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/27a1398ffa2f13db235929257926672bc10dc6e4.png"][/img][/p][h2]New UI[/h2][p]The UI has been given a face lift! Away with the oversaturation of blue and in with a lost sailor feel, featuring pages and books that feel as though you're logging everything as you fish day to day.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/a26ec40959b1772658ee3c2cd5bd289fc84a8441.png"][/img][/p][p]Fishing will now feel less about the numbers with bars to measure distance and depth, as well as a new follow-net system where the fish you catch will follow your lure! You can see how many nets you have left for fish just by looking![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/9b233c69883ada4c8713cb90dfd8fae1b3131a86.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Stu, New Art![/h2][p]And finally I've had some very talented artists create some absolutely gorgeous new artwork for the game![/p][p]First off we have a whole new Stu by [url="https://www.fiverr.com/inbox/sansh_pixel"]@sansh_pixel[/url] on Fiver. Love this new more detailed design![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/25d8b54944a0d00b9188ad1d6637fcd008342445.gif"][/img] [/p][p]And secondly we have this incredible new banner art by [url="https://www.fiverr.com/inbox/sheilenwei"]@sheilenwei[/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/57914f9406f355e1a98f1fcfaa234997542251e0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I hope that you all enjoy this update as much as I've enjoy making it![/p][p][/p][p]All my best,[/p][p]Ben[/p][p]Savvy Games[/p]

notes.title: July Development Update
notes.content: [h1]Development Update July 2025[/h1][p][/p][p]Hi everyone! Thank you all for a great first couple of weeks with Stu the fisherman, I've been enjoying getting all of your feedback and making improvements from said feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]This update will cover some of the bits coming soon to give you an idea on how development is progressing.[/p][p][/p][h2]New UI![/h2][p]I've developed some new, much sleeker UI for the game, giving it more of a fisherman's log / travellers journal feeling![/p][p][/p][p]The log and fisherman's shops have been adjusted into these beautiful book formats with tabs and defined structure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/d83aadb25e3e921030e177801e4b37f82a47cdc3.png"][/img][/p][h2]Scoring, Progression and Flair[/h2][p]A whole new progression system has been added revolving around progressing up a forever growing target score. Each target met will have a reward such as Wood, Food, Metal or even Trinkets![/p][p][/p][p]Interactions with fish and scoring now have bursts of particles and shaking to add energy and feeling to your progression.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/892cb63b91ca8988074e6dd69eccbf37598cbb95.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/edebee64a58e78775ba739bb437e2a18ccbd28d4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/ef420ab5b0d4ce92a3a83a4feae61f7519cd6ca6.png"][/img][/carousel][h2]Rainbows![/h2][p]A whole new fish variation and numerous Trinkets to interact with that new variation.[/p][p][/p][p]Rainbow fish count as any colour, meaning that they trigger all of your blue, red [i]and[/i] green trinkets during scoring. New trinkets involve abilities such as converting fish to be rainbow when caught![/p][p][/p][h2]Outro[/h2][p]Once again, thanks all, I look forward to seeing your feedback with this next update. I'm incredibly proud of how much the game is progressing.[/p][p][/p][p]All my best,[/p][p]Ben[/p][p]Savvy Games[/p]

notes.title: We're Live!
notes.content: [h1]And we're LIVE![/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to everybody who has believed in this project so far, you all mean a lot and are incredibly appreciated![/p][p][/p][p]I thought I would take this first update to share with you where the game is heading over the next year with our roadmap![/p][p][/p][p]The first few months are going to focus on fixes and improvement based on feedback from people like yourself! This includes changes to the game economy, adding flare to the scoring and animations, as well as all new features like the rainbow fish (which counts as any colour) and trinkets to create all new combinations with.[/p][p][/p][p]Following on from that the focus will be on adding new mechanics, such as the sky fishing biome, an arcade mode that allows endless fishing separate to the story and the continuation of Stu's story itself.[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to keep up with development and get involved with how this game will develop please join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/fggphksBC4" style="button"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45541058/d1fbbb4931f4b73f96b82b3fc1a1b38fffabb074.png"][/img][/p][p]Once again, thank you so much, and I look forward to the future of Stu.[/p][p][/p][p]All my best,[/p][p]Ben[/p][p]Savvy Games[/p]
